summary: Iteration 14: Vehicle color filter case-insensitivity + 13-color palette + AI scenario alerts (7 scenarios) engine and UI. Backend pytest 9/9 passed (color case-insensitive filter, GET/PUT /api/ai/alert-rules with 7 scenarios, PUT clean of unknown keys, enfant_route alert exists with thumbnail/severity/camera/timestamp, intrusion_nocturne triggered within 90s when night window is widened, no _id leak). Frontend Playwright verified: /vehicles page exposes all 13 colors including Jaune/Orange/Violet/Rose/Marron/Beige, auto-search debounced fires GET /api/plates?color=Gris on change (no button click required), /alerts page has data-testid=ai-rules-btn opening a dialog listing all 7 rule toggles (ai-rule-intrusion_nocturne, rodeur, attroupement, vive_allure, collision, enfant_route, vol_vehicule) with ai-rules-save-btn. Real enfant_route + intrusion_nocturne alerts render with data-testid=alert-thumbnail, CRITICAL badge, camera name (Caméra Démo Trafic), timestamp.
